title: Hiring Signals by Company Domain input

domains.title: Company domains or websites
domains.description: Required unless datasetId is set. Array of strings: company domains, website URLs or work emails, e.g. ["stripe.com","https://www.notion.so","jane@ramp.com"]. Emails are reduced to the domain; the part before @ is never stored. Returns one row per domain with isHiring, openJobs, jobsByFunction, signals and status.

maxDomains.title: Max domains
maxDomains.description: Check at most this many unique domains per run (default 1000) to keep cost predictable. Aliases: maxItems, limit, maxResults.

datasetId.title: Or: dataset ID from another Actor
datasetId.description: Optional. Read domains from another run's dataset, e.g. Google Maps, lead lists or swillz/company-website-enrichment results. Example: "aBcD1234efGH5678". In an integration the triggering run's dataset is used automatically.

domainField.title: Domain field in that dataset
domainField.description: Field holding the domain, website or email, e.g. "website" (dot paths like "company.domain" work). Leave empty to auto-detect (domain, companyDomain, website, websiteUrl, companyWebsite, url, email).

datasetMaxItems.title: Max values from the dataset
datasetMaxItems.description: Read at most this many values from the dataset (default 1000).

scanWebsite.title: Find the job board on the company website
scanWebsite.description: Read the homepage and careers page (respecting robots.txt) to find the linked Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable or Recruitee board. Most accurate. Turn off to only guess board names (faster).

probeBoardNames.title: Guess board names when none is linked
probeBoardNames.description: If the site links no board, try the domain's name (stripe.com -> "stripe") on each ATS. A guessed board is kept only if its company name or job URLs match the domain (matchConfidence high/medium).

includeLowConfidence.title: Keep uncorroborated name matches
includeLowConfidence.description: Also return boards that only share the board name, with matchConfidence "low" (they may belong to another company). Off by default: such domains return status no_public_board_found with a possibleBoard hint.

sampleJobsPerDomain.title: Sample jobs per domain
sampleJobsPerDomain.description: Newest job titles to include in sampleJobs (0-25, default 5). For every job, chain to swillz/career-site-jobs-scraper.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max website pages per domain
maxPagesPerSite.description: Website pages read per domain to find the board: homepage + careers links (1-6, default 3).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually not needed: job-board APIs are public. Use Apify Proxy if many company sites block datacenter IPs.
